title: Off-map placement validation tests exercise only the x-axis; y-bounds untested
detail: Both off-map cases (negative x, x == w_tiles) fix y=6; no y = -1 or y == h_tiles (30) case exists, so a regression in placement_valid's y-bound (e.g. swapped h_tiles) passes green.
recommended_fix: Add two cases in test_place_rejects_invalid_spots: pos = {6, -2} and pos = {6, 30}, asserting .Invalid_Placement, mirroring the existing x-axis cases.

title: No junction-to-junction draw test: both-endpoint port consumption unpinned
detail: Every port-limit test draws junction-to-terminal (res_type is a terminal), so validate_draw's `!ports_available(t, sa) || !ports_available(t, sb)` is never exercised with two junction endpoints each consuming a port. A per-endpoint-count regression would stay green.
recommended_fix: Add a test that draws a pipe between two basic routers and pins that each endpoint consumes one port (e.g. 4 junction-junction draws fill both sides).

title: App-layer placement input paths (tray arm/cancel, ESC/right-click, press-move guard, chip swallow) have zero automated coverage
detail: All *_test.odin files live in core/; the GPU app has no test infra and the harness passes a zeroed Drag_State ("goldens never see a ghost"), so tray arm/cancel, ESC/right-click, the >6px movement guard and chip-swallow are unverified. Acceptable-by-design for the playable layer, but a stated blind spot.
recommended_fix: If the app-layer FSM ever grows a test seam, extract the press/release/cancel decisions into a pure function core tests can drive; otherwise document the manual QA dependency.

title: mouse_tile truncates negative world coords to tile 0: left/top letterbox clicks place at the map edge, ghost puck disagrees
detail: At 1280x720 the camera-fit leaves off_x = 160px letterbox (scale 0.9231); i32() truncates toward zero, so clicks left of the map yield tile 0, which placement_valid accepts, while draw_place_ghost draws the puck at the cursor. Right/bottom letterbox correctly rejects via >= w_tiles.
recommended_fix: Floor (or round) in mouse_tile: use i32(math.floor(wx / tile)) so negative world px yield negative tiles that core validation rejects, matching the ghost position.

title: place.dem header comment contradicts its own capture directives; the two T2 PNGs are byte-identical
location: demos/place.dem (header comment vs capture lines); goldens/place/
evidence:
# T2 captures: 1250ms (t25) pins the settled placement + the new pipe; 3000ms
# pins the settled topology. T1 hashes + the replay gate pin placement +
# draw byte-identically (the placement is a logged command, re-applied from
# the blessed log on every replay — E10).
seed 42
run 4000ms
at 500ms place router_basic 20 5
at 1500ms draw 1 3 standard
capture at 2500ms
capture at 3000ms
detail: Comment says "1250ms (t25)" but the directives capture at 2500ms/3000ms, and both PNGs are byte-identical (settled topology) — the 3000ms capture is redundant. The golden DOES pin the placement: pixel analysis shows the router puck at (20,5) and the vertical pipe to (20,15).
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to "2500ms (t50)", and drop the redundant 3000ms capture (or keep both and note they pin the settled state).

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: terminal-reject, replay byte-identical, v2-log rejection, one-byte re-bless (verified byte 5 only on all 9 logs), port-cap enforcement, T2 golden all pinned; negative controls bite. P1 ~95% (off-map y-bounds the only partial). Overall ~90%; remaining gaps (dual-junction draw, app-layer input, letterbox clamp) are P3.
recommended_fix: Add the two P3 core tests (y-bounds off-map, junction-to-junction port consumption) to reach full-path coverage; app-layer input stays a documented manual-QA seam.
